messages:
Asha (CS): Heads-up: Northbridge pilot blocked by SSO seat mapping. They need live seats for an exec demo next Tue. Missing `employeeId` claim in SAML and our seat CSV doesn't align. Can @Ben and @Lia advise?

Ben (Eng): please paste the SAML assertion snippet or IdP test output so we can see missing attributes. If it's just mapping, we can do a manual reconciliation for the pilot.

Asha (CS): pasted redacted assertion below — employeeId absent.

```
<saml:Assertion>...<saml:Attribute Name=\"email\">alice@northbridge.com</saml:Attribute>...</saml:Assertion>
```

Lia (SE): two quick paths: 1) run a CSV->account reconciliation I can script, or 2) provision a short-lived tenant flag that skips employeeId validation. Manual recon is lowest-risk.

Asha (CS): go with manual recon. Also need an enablement slot Wed/Thu afternoon PT — customer prefers Wed 3pm.

Ben (Eng): I'll build a tiny helper script and hand it to Lia. ETA ~4 hrs to review. If the recon surfaces edge cases, I'll prepare a small validation patch behind a feature flag.

Diego (Support): opened IdP ticket SB-4123 to request employeeId claim from their admin.

Maya (Renewals): noted — renewal in ~6 weeks. Treat as high priority; keep me posted on demo outcome.

sched-bot: calendar event created: \"Northbridge enablement 3 Mar 2024 15:00 PT\" (invites sent).

Lia (SE): will run reconciliation during the scheduled window and attach the mapping CSV to SB-4123. I'll also include a 1-question micro-eval at the end (rwd.co/eval-lite).

Asha (CS): thanks team. I'll confirm Wed 3pm with the customer and grant Lia a 3-hour admin window.
